headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2023, Aussie Open vs. The Hardys went to battle over the ROH World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.43. For The Hardys, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. This stood as the 10th match in ROH World Tag Team Titles history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Flash back to 2024, when Cage, Mortos & TV made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.49.
It was 2025 when James Drake made their return to AEW television after 3 months away, appearing on Collision.

secondaries.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Fox & Strickland touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.41 ? a solid showing.
2024 brought us this moment: Robyn Renegade was back in action after just over 3 months away, appearing on Rampage.
That Saturday in 2025, Konosuke Takeshita vs. Tomohiro Ishii crossed paths for the first time ever on Collision, rated 7.84 ? a good, competitive contest.
